This is a part of a passenger vehicle, so it falls in heading 8708 (parts and accessories of motor vehicles) if it is not covered elsewhere. A floor pad that sits beneath the mat could instead be treated as a textile floor covering or as a plastic article, but it is a shaped plastic and foam part with a fiber pad inside. It is not a floor mat in the 5703 or 3918 sense. Chapter 87 therefore appears to be the best fit.

Within 8708, the "other parts and accessories" subheading is 8708.99. Its subdivisions are 8708.99.81 ("Other: Other"), 8708.99.68 and 8708.99.55, and the final 10-digit statistical suffix under 8708.99.81 is 8708.99.8180 ("Other"). I am recalling these numbers from memory and have not checked them against the current schedule.

I considered the other 8708 subheadings. 8708.29 covers other body parts and accessories, but a pad under the floor mat is not a body part such as a stamped panel. It is also not a safety seat belt or an airbag. The general residual 8708.99.8180 is therefore the most likely classification.
